title: Morgan Stanley Capital Partners invests in World 50
investment_thesis: An invitation-only executive network built around trusted peer exchange, membership relationships and knowledge access.

research_insights.label: Membership scale
research_insights.value: World 50 served more than 1,700 senior executives at major global organizations through invitation-only private peer communities at the time of the investment.

research_insights.label: Retention signal
research_insights.value: MSCP highlighted World 50's high member retention and Net Promoter Score as evidence of the strength of the member experience.

research_insights.label: Growth plan
research_insights.value: The ownership plan centered on broader networks, richer member experiences, geographic expansion, technology and acquisitions.

research_insights.label: Management alignment
research_insights.value: Existing management retained leadership and rolled a substantial amount of transaction proceeds into the new ownership structure.

people_roles.attribution: Quoted on World 50's peer-to-peer platform, growth record and company culture.

people_roles.label: official_transaction_spokesperson
people_roles.attribution: Quoted on broadening World 50's networks and enriching the member experience.

title: World 50 moves into an MSCP continuation vehicle
investment_thesis: Extended ownership of an executive-network platform to support further product, membership and acquisition-led growth.

research_insights.label: Continuation structure
research_insights.value: MSCP sold World 50 into a single-asset GP-led continuation vehicle that remained under an MSCP affiliate, offering liquidity while extending sponsor ownership.

research_insights.label: Investor group
research_insights.value: Pantheon led the continuation fund, with Blue Owl Strategic Equity and Lexington as co-leads and commitments from Norwest, Ares Management funds, AltamarCAM and Churchill.

research_insights.label: Network scale
research_insights.value: World 50 said its member organizations represented more than $34 trillion of market capitalization and over 37 million employees across six continents.

research_insights.label: Value-creation thesis
research_insights.value: MSCP described product and service expansion, continuous improvement of the member experience, organic growth and acquisitions as the main levers for the next ownership period.

title: Charterhouse agrees sale of Tarsus to Informa
investment_thesis: Strategic combination of complementary international B2B events portfolios, specialist audiences and first-party data.

people_roles.label: official_transaction_spokesperson
people_roles.attribution: Named and quoted in Informa's official transaction announcement as the Charterhouse partner responsible for the investment.

research_insights.label: Audience scale
research_insights.value: The top ten Tarsus brands reached approximately 515,000 attendees and more than 8,350 exhibitors.

research_insights.label: Transaction economics
research_insights.value: The $940 million initial enterprise value represented approximately 9.9 times post-synergy EBITDA for 2023 and 2024, falling below 9 times for 2024 and 2025.

research_insights.label: Value creation plan
research_insights.value: Informa identified more than $20 million of annual operating synergies plus cross-marketing, digital expansion, new launches and integration of Tarsus audience data into IIRIS.

research_insights.label: Funding and closing
research_insights.value: Consideration combined cash with $210 million of Informa shares. Informa's results record completion on 17 April 2023 and repayment of £443.9 million of acquired debt.

research_insights.label: Transaction economics
research_insights.value: The documented purchase price was $948.7 million. Nielsen separately described total cash consideration of $950 million subject to closing adjustments.

research_insights.label: Ownership period
research_insights.value: Onex records its investment period as June 2013 through May 2026 under the Onex Partners platform.

research_insights.value: Evanta primarily generated revenue from event sponsorship fees, with seasonality concentrated in the second and fourth quarters.

provider_roles.role: financial adviser and fairness-opinion provider to CEB

research_insights.label: Transaction structure
research_insights.value: Gartner agreed to pay CEB shareholders cash plus Gartner shares in a transaction valued at approximately $2.6 billion.

research_insights.label: Community adjacency
research_insights.value: CEB combined membership-based research and decision support with executive briefings, destination events and the Evanta C-suite community business.

research_insights.label: Scale strategy
research_insights.value: Gartner positioned the combination as a way to serve major enterprise functions with a broader research and advisory platform.

research_insights.label: Process evidence
research_insights.value: The joint proxy documents the negotiation process and identifies Centerview for CEB and Goldman Sachs and Evercore for Gartner.
